command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
# 42.4 GB of zips: on the root disk (disk_gib), not the half-RAM /tmp tmpfs
mkdir -p /work/out
python3 -u fetch.py /work/out > /tmp/fetch.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat /tmp/fetch.log
df -h /work | tail -n 1
[ "$RC" = 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: fetch"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
